mapper.sql: select p.post_id, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.title, cast(p.content as char) as content, p.summary, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.collect_count, p.is_top, p.is_essence, p.is_anonymous, p.is_admin_push, p.post_type, p.response_dept_id, p.status, p.audit_reason, p.del_flag, p.last_reply_time,p.create_time,p.create_by, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.category_name, coalesce(p.response_dept_name, d.dept_name) as response_dept_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '匿名用户' else p.nick_name end as nick_name, case when p.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else p.avatar end as avatar from bbs_post p left join bbs_category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_dept d on p.response_dept_id = d.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where p.user_id = #{hashCode} and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.create_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into bbs_post
category_id, user_id, title, content, summary, view_count, like_count, comment_count, collect_count, is_top, is_essence, is_anonymous, is_admin_push, post_type, response_dept_id, response_dept_name, status, audit_reason, del_flag, remark, nick_name, avatar, create_by, create_time
#{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{collectCount}, #{isTop}, #{isEssence}, #{isAnonymous}, #{isAdminPush}, #{postType}, #{responseDeptId}, #{responseDeptName}, #{status}, #{auditReason}, #{delFlag}, #{remark}, #{nickName}, #{avatar}, #{createBy}, sysdate()
mapper.delete: update bbs_post set status = '1', del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update bbs_post set view_count = view_count + 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set like_count = like_count + 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set like_count = like_count - 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set comment_count = comment_count + 1, last_reply_time = sysdate() where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set comment_count = comment_count - 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set collect_count = collect_count + 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set collect_count = collect_count - 1 where post_id = #{postId}
update bbs_post set last_reply_time = sysdate(), last_reply_user = #{lastReplyUser} where post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status != '4' order by p.create_time desc
select count(*) from bbs_post where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' and status != '4'
select status, count(*) as cnt from bbs_post where del_flag = '0' and status != '4' group by status
select coalesce(post_type, 'share') as post_type, count(*) as cnt from bbs_post where del_flag = '0' and status != '4' group by post_type

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_str, count(*) as cnt from bbs_post where del_flag = '0' and status != '4' and create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date_str asc

select p.nick_name, count(*) as post_cnt, sum(p.view_count) as total_views, sum(p.like_count) as total_likes from bbs_post p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and p.is_anonymous = '0' group by p.nick_name order by post_cnt desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as total_posts, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as published_count, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as rejected_count, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as closed_count, sum(case when is_anonymous = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as anonymous_count, sum(view_count) as total_views, sum(like_count) as total_likes, sum(comment_count) as total_comments from bbs_post where del_flag = '0' and status != '4'
